actual_literal_definitions.formula: c(y,xRef) = y − η • gradient V xRef
actual_literal_definitions.semantics: One actual center; fixed y and xRef throughout every finite history.

actual_literal_definitions.formula: h(xRef,x) = gradient V x − gradient V xRef
actual_literal_definitions.semantics: Actual gradient difference, never a supplied arbitrary residual or Lipschitz field.

actual_literal_definitions.formula: R_a p = p − (2 * inner a p / ‖a‖²) • a for a ≠ 0; R_0 p = p
actual_literal_definitions.semantics: Piecewise zero-safe specular reflection; no continuity premise at a=0.

actual_literal_definitions.formula: Φ_t(x,p) = (c+(cos t)•(x−c)+(sqrt η*sin t)•p, −(sin t/sqrt η)•(x−c)+(cos t)•p)
actual_literal_definitions.semantics: Finite real t only; η>0 fixes positive square root. No Φ_∞.
Position unchanged; actual zero-safe bounce. Borel is required internally; continuous S is unavailable.

actual_literal_definitions.formula: λ(x,p) = sqrt η * max(0, inner p (h(xRef,x)))
actual_literal_definitions.semantics: Nonnegative actual PBPS rate, not a supplied bounded rate or generic hazard.
Weighted SUM of position and momentum energies. E0 is exactly the original phase energy, not a caller-provided envelope.

u:NNReal, finite real-time integral. Continuous and nondecreasing are producer facts, not public assumptions.

actual_literal_definitions.formula: τ(z,e) = inf {u:NNReal | e ≤ Λ(z,u)} : WithTop NNReal
actual_literal_definitions.semantics: Closed ≥ hitting set; inf empty=∞. e=0 gives τ=0. No-hit positive threshold may give ∞. Finite endpoint equality and joint Borel must come from actual75, whose fresh independent source admission is pending.

actual_literal_definitions.formula: Record = Sum (NNReal × (E × E)) Unit; time(inl(T,z))=↑T; time(inr())=∞
actual_literal_definitions.semantics: Honest total representation of finite active postjump records and stopped marker. Stopped has no phase; no phase at∞ and no hidden arbitrary-state fallback.

actual_literal_definitions.formula: step(inr(),e)=inr(); step(inl(T,z),e)=inr() if τ(z,e)=∞, else inl(T+s, S(Φ_s(z))) for τ(z,e)=↑s
actual_literal_definitions.semantics: Extract finite s only after guard. e=0 performs the literal zero-time S bounce and may repeat T. Marker absorption is total bookkeeping after source stop.

actual_literal_definitions.formula: r_0=inl(0,z0); r_(n+1)=step(r_n,e_n), with e_n = source E_(n+1)
actual_literal_definitions.semantics: Each finite n depends only on threshold prefix e_0,…,e_(n−1). For deterministic e:Nat→NNReal this is an explicitly labelled extension of the source positive-iid construction, not an all-time physical path.
A local finite-time arc only. Claim ζ_(T_n+t)=arc_n(t) as a single physical process requires later nonaccumulation/strict-positive clocks and stitching.
